description: Land Title Settlement Department - Gorakana, Panadura D/S Division, Kalutara District - Cad. Map No. 530012
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed declarations of land title determinations for specific parcels of land, including parcel numbers, owner names, extent of land, encumbrances, and other land-specific details. The content falls squarely within the Land Gazette category as it involves land registrations, property ownership determinations, and title settlements without any government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other non-land administrative matters.
